name: Bob
blurb: Bob is a lackadaisical teenager. In conversation, his responses are very limited.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to determine what Bob will reply to someone when they say something to him or ask him a question.

Bob only ever answers one of five things:

- **"Sure."**
  This is his response if you ask him a question, such as "How are you?"
  The convention used for questions is that it ends with a question mark.
- **"Whoa, chill out!"**
  This is his answer if you YELL AT HIM.
  The convention used for yelling is ALL CAPITAL LETTERS.
- **"Calm down, I know what I'm doing!"**
  This is what he says if you yell a question at him.
- **"Fine. Be that way!"**
  This is how he responds to silence.
  The convention used for silence is nothing, or various combinations of whitespace characters.
- **"Whatever."**
  This is what he answers to anything else.
introduction:
# Introduction

Bob is a [lackadaisical][] teenager.
He likes to think that he's very cool.
And he definitely doesn't get excited about things.
That wouldn't be cool.

When people talk to him, his responses are pretty limited.

[lackadaisical]: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/lackadaisical
starter_code:
# Respond to a phrase as Bob would
# Response ? Phrase
HeyBob ← |1 ⊙(⍤ "Please implement HeyBob" 0)
example_solution:
AssertQuestion       ← ⍤. ⧻ regex "\\?$"
AssertYelled         ← ⍤. × (≥1⧻ regex "[A-Z]+") : (≍⌵) ..
AssertWhitespace     ← ⍤. ⧻ regex "[\\W]*"

HeyBob ← |1 ⍣(
  "Calm down, I know what I'm doing!" ⊃AssertQuestion AssertYelled
| "Sure." AssertQuestion
| "Whoa, chill out!" AssertYelled
| "Fine. Be that way!" AssertWhitespace
| "Whatever."
)
test_code:
~ "bob.ua" ~ HeyBob

# prolonged silence?
⍤⤙≍ "Fine. Be that way!" HeyBob "    "

# silence?
⍤⤙≍ "Fine. Be that way!" HeyBob ""

# shouting numbers?
⍤⤙≍ "Whoa, chill out!" HeyBob "1 2 3 GO!"

# no letters?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "1 2 3"

# question with no letters?
⍤⤙≍ "Sure." HeyBob "4?"

# multiple line question?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "Does this cryogenic chamber make me look fat?\nno"

# asking a question?
⍤⤙≍ "Sure." HeyBob "Does this cryogenic chamber make me look fat?"

# statement containing question mark?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "Ending with ? means a question."

# shouting with no exclamation mark?
⍤⤙≍ "Whoa, chill out!" HeyBob "I HATE YOU"

# using acronyms in regular speech?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "It's OK if you don't want to go to the DMV."

# speaking forcefully?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "Let's go make out behind the gym!"

# stating something?
⍤⤙≍ "Whatever." HeyBob "Tom-ay-to, tom-aaaah-to."

# shouting?
⍤⤙≍ "Whoa, chill out!" HeyBob "WATCH OUT!"

# forceful question?
⍤⤙≍ "Calm down, I know what I'm doing!" HeyBob "WHAT THE HELL WERE YOU THINKING?"

# prattling on?
⍤⤙≍ "Sure." HeyBob "Wait! Hang on. Are you going to be OK?"

# asking a numeric question?
⍤⤙≍ "Sure." HeyBob "You are, what, like 15?"

# shouting with special characters?
⍤⤙≍ "Whoa, chill out!" HeyBob "ZOMG THE %^*@#$(*^ ZOMBIES ARE COMING!!11!!1!"
